cards.title: Moon Muffin Clipboard Counter Paragraph
cards.paragraphFocusSkill: choose one main idea, keep two useful details, and remove one extra idea
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable clipboard paragraph focus card for building one focused moon muffin market paragraph on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Place this card on a clipboard with blank paper and choose one pretend market moment to focus on: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: Keep the paragraph about one moon muffin idea, then choose two details that help it: ____________________.
cards.mainIdeaPrompt: Main idea: The paragraph is mostly about one glowing muffin tray at the counter: ____________________.
cards.detailOnePrompt: Useful detail one: Add one detail about the tray, wrapper, or tiny paper label: ____________________.
cards.detailTwoPrompt: Useful detail two: Add one detail about what the helper notices beside the tray: ____________________.
cards.detailOrderPrompt: Detail order: Choose which useful detail should come first so the paragraph is easy to follow: ____________________.
cards.linkingSentencePrompt: Linking sentence: Write one sentence that connects both details back to the glowing muffin tray: ____________________.
cards.cutExtraPrompt: Cut extra idea: Cross out one fun idea that does not help this muffin-tray paragraph: ____________________.
cards.finalParagraphPrompt: Final focused paragraph: Copy the main idea, two useful details, linking sentence, and no extra idea: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Point to the main idea and write only the two useful details first: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Later paper line: Try another focused paragraph about a moon crumb card or silver wrapper: ____________________.
